_comment: Completion gate for a SYMLINK install (issue #262). hooks/hooks.json wires the gate through ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}, which Claude Code sets only for plugin installs -- a `ln -s` into ~/.claude/skills/ loads no plugin, so it gets no gate. This snippet is the same two hooks with an absolute path instead. Merge it into ~/.claude/settings.json (user) or .claude/settings.json (project). Run hooks/print-settings-snippet.sh from the clone to get this file with the placeholder already resolved. Delete the _comment keys before use if your settings reader is strict.
